description: blast-physics-js is a JavaScript library from the Blasting Apps and Kirra developer for modelling mine-blast effects. It exposes analytical models for vibration, rock damage and movement, with typed-array outputs for grid calculations and support for monitor CSV inputs and Kirra project information. The package runs in browser or Node.js environments without a rendering dependency. Users supply site geometry, material properties and calibrated model parameters; geography and resolution follow the chosen mine and computational grid, not a fixed dataset. Public source and npm installation instructions are free under MIT. The README records a material correction in version 0.3.0: several earlier implementations disagreed with their cited papers, so results from version 0.2.x need review before comparison. The availability of equations and demonstrations does not establish site-specific accuracy or suitability for operational blast design. The library is relevant to mining-asset exposure and engineering model development, but no directly compatible catalogue model was identified. This review recorded metadata and documentation only, without executing models or adopting their numerical predictions.
